data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

edge_embedded.name: graphify
edge_embedded.summary: Graphify 是一个 AI 编码助手技能，能将任意包含代码、SQL 模式、R 脚本、Shell 脚本、文档、论文、图片或视频的文件夹转化为可查询的知识图谱。它无缝集成 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Gemini CLI 等工具。其核心技术亮点是使用 tree-sitter 进行精确代码解析，并用 Leiden 算法进行图谱聚类，从而将应用代码、数据库模式和基础设施统一在同一图中。开发者可通过自然语言问答快速理解复杂代码库、发现隐性依赖，加速代码评审、调试或新成员入职。
edge_embedded.summary_en: Graphify is an AI coding assistant skill that transforms any folder of code, schemas, scripts, docs, images, or videos into a queryable knowledge graph. It integrates with tools like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Its key technical insight is using tree-sitter for precise code parsing and Leiden for graph clustering, enabling cross-domain understanding of app code, database schema, and infrastructure in one graph. Developers can instantly query complex codebases, uncover hidden dependencies, and accelerate onboarding or debugging by asking natural language questions against the graph.

ui_devex.name: OpenCut
ui_devex.summary: OpenCut 是一个开源视频编辑器，旨在成为 CapCut 的免费替代品，让用户摆脱专有软件的限制。它使用 TypeScript 构建，模块化架构支持跨平台部署，并通过节点式合成系统实现图层和特效的精细控制。此外，其插件机制允许社区贡献功能，实时预览加速编辑流程。你可以用它进行视频剪辑、添加字幕、滤镜和转场，开发者可轻松扩展或集成。适用于视频创作、社交媒体内容制作以及教育用途。
ui_devex.summary_en: OpenCut is an open-source video editor serving as a free alternative to CapCut, enabling anyone to edit videos without proprietary restrictions. Its modular, TypeScript-based architecture ensures cross-platform compatibility and extensibility, while the node-based composition system provides granular control over effects and layers. Typical use cases include video production, social media content creation, and custom editing pipelines. Developers can extend or embed it easily.

ui_devex.name: grok2api
ui_devex.summary: grok2api 是一个专为 Grok Build、Grok Web 与 Grok Console 设计的多账号 API 网关，核心目标是统一管理多个 Grok 账号的访问入口，解决多账号轮询、负载均衡和密钥管理问题。它采用 Go 语言开发，具备高性能与低延迟特点，支持自动故障切换，确保高可用性。典型用法是部署为反向代理层，透明转发请求，开发者无需关心底层账号细节即可安全调用 Grok 服务。适合需要将 Grok 能力集成到自有应用、进行批量调用或团队共享使用的场景，部署简单，可快速提升 API 调用的稳定性和扩展性。
ui_devex.summary_en: grok2api is a multi-account API gateway for Grok services (Build, Web, Console), unifying access and managing credentials. Built in Go, it offers high performance, load balancing, and automatic failover across accounts for reliability. You can deploy it as a reverse proxy to route requests, simplify authentication, and scale usage without exposing individual API keys—ideal for integrating Grok into applications or teams.

ui_devex.name: Clypra
ui_devex.summary: Clypra 是一款基于 Tauri、React 和 TypeScript 构建的现代视频编辑器，旨在免费替代 CapCut 等软件的付费功能。其核心优势在于 Tauri 提供轻量级桌面运行时，结合 React 组件化 UI，实现接近原生的性能并降低 Web 开发者上手门槛。支持视频剪辑、特效添加，模块化设计可扩展自定义过渡或插件。适合视频创作者和前端开发者，兼具实用工具与学习样本价值。
ui_devex.summary_en: Clypra is a modern video editor built with Tauri, React, and TypeScript, aiming to provide free alternatives to premium CapCut features. Its key technical strength lies in combining Tauri's lightweight desktop runtime with React's component-based UI, enabling near-native performance with familiar web development workflows. You can use it for full-featured video editing or extend its capabilities through its modular design. Try building custom transitions or effects using its plugin-friendly architecture.

ui_devex.summary_en: Graphify is an AI coding assistant skill that transforms any folder of code, schemas, scripts, docs, images, or videos into a queryable knowledge graph. It integrates with tools like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Its key technical insight is using tree-sitter for precise code parsing and Leiden for graph clustering, enabling cross-domain understanding of app code, database schema, and infrastructure in one graph. Developers can instantly query complex codebases, uncover hidden dependencies, and accelerate onboarding or debugging by asking natural language questions against the graph.

deployment_serving.name: OpenCut
deployment_serving.summary: OpenCut 是一个开源视频编辑器，旨在成为 CapCut 的免费替代品，让用户摆脱专有软件的限制。它使用 TypeScript 构建，模块化架构支持跨平台部署，并通过节点式合成系统实现图层和特效的精细控制。此外，其插件机制允许社区贡献功能，实时预览加速编辑流程。你可以用它进行视频剪辑、添加字幕、滤镜和转场，开发者可轻松扩展或集成。适用于视频创作、社交媒体内容制作以及教育用途。
deployment_serving.summary_en: OpenCut is an open-source video editor serving as a free alternative to CapCut, enabling anyone to edit videos without proprietary restrictions. Its modular, TypeScript-based architecture ensures cross-platform compatibility and extensibility, while the node-based composition system provides granular control over effects and layers. Typical use cases include video production, social media content creation, and custom editing pipelines. Developers can extend or embed it easily.

deployment_serving.name: grok2api
deployment_serving.summary: grok2api 是一个专为 Grok Build、Grok Web 与 Grok Console 设计的多账号 API 网关，核心目标是统一管理多个 Grok 账号的访问入口，解决多账号轮询、负载均衡和密钥管理问题。它采用 Go 语言开发，具备高性能与低延迟特点，支持自动故障切换，确保高可用性。典型用法是部署为反向代理层，透明转发请求，开发者无需关心底层账号细节即可安全调用 Grok 服务。适合需要将 Grok 能力集成到自有应用、进行批量调用或团队共享使用的场景，部署简单，可快速提升 API 调用的稳定性和扩展性。
deployment_serving.summary_en: grok2api is a multi-account API gateway for Grok services (Build, Web, Console), unifying access and managing credentials. Built in Go, it offers high performance, load balancing, and automatic failover across accounts for reliability. You can deploy it as a reverse proxy to route requests, simplify authentication, and scale usage without exposing individual API keys—ideal for integrating Grok into applications or teams.

framework_core.summary: OpenCut 是一个开源视频编辑器，旨在成为 CapCut 的免费替代品，让用户摆脱专有软件的限制。它使用 TypeScript 构建，模块化架构支持跨平台部署，并通过节点式合成系统实现图层和特效的精细控制。此外，其插件机制允许社区贡献功能，实时预览加速编辑流程。你可以用它进行视频剪辑、添加字幕、滤镜和转场，开发者可轻松扩展或集成。适用于视频创作、社交媒体内容制作以及教育用途。
framework_core.summary_en: OpenCut is an open-source video editor serving as a free alternative to CapCut, enabling anyone to edit videos without proprietary restrictions. Its modular, TypeScript-based architecture ensures cross-platform compatibility and extensibility, while the node-based composition system provides granular control over effects and layers. Typical use cases include video production, social media content creation, and custom editing pipelines. Developers can extend or embed it easily.

framework_core.name: Clypra
framework_core.summary: Clypra 是一款基于 Tauri、React 和 TypeScript 构建的现代视频编辑器，旨在免费替代 CapCut 等软件的付费功能。其核心优势在于 Tauri 提供轻量级桌面运行时，结合 React 组件化 UI，实现接近原生的性能并降低 Web 开发者上手门槛。支持视频剪辑、特效添加，模块化设计可扩展自定义过渡或插件。适合视频创作者和前端开发者，兼具实用工具与学习样本价值。
framework_core.summary_en: Clypra is a modern video editor built with Tauri, React, and TypeScript, aiming to provide free alternatives to premium CapCut features. Its key technical strength lies in combining Tauri's lightweight desktop runtime with React's component-based UI, enabling near-native performance with familiar web development workflows. You can use it for full-featured video editing or extend its capabilities through its modular design. Try building custom transitions or effects using its plugin-friendly architecture.
